crossRefs.note: Not that I seek for the gift, but I seek for the fruit that increases to your account.
which has come to you, even as it is in all the world and is bearing fruit and growing, as it does in you also, since…
whenever I travel to Spain, I will come to you. For I hope to see you on my journey, and to be helped on my way there…
There are many plans in a man’s heart, but Yahweh’s counsel will prevail.
Who is he who says, and it comes to pass, when the Lord doesn’t command it?
Come now, you who say, “Today or tomorrow let’s go into this city, and spend a year there, trade, and make a profit.”

people.name: Spain
people.line: Country Paul intended to visit to preach gospel

translations.web: When therefore I have accomplished this, and have sealed to them this fruit, I will go on by way of you to Spain.
translations.bsb: So after I have completed this service and have safely delivered this bounty to them, I will set off to Spain by way of you.
translations.kjv: When therefore I have performed this, and have sealed to them this fruit, I will come by you into Spain.
translations.asv: When therefore I have accomplished this, and have sealed to them this fruit, I will go on by you unto Spain.
